strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Yu fayl dɛn
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Dɛn de sɛnd am ɛnkrip (HTTPS), wok na am awtomatikali, dɔn dɛlɛt am wantɛm we di rizin redi. Big fayl dɛn de go na tɛmpɔri storij na random nem ɛn dɛn de klia am wantɛm we di wok dɔn; awtomatik klia-klia de klia ɛnitin we de lida witin 24 awa.

strings.legal.security.title: Sikyuriti ɛn deta
strings.legal.security.description: Wetin de apin fɔ yu fayl na pdffusion: awtomatik prosesing, no anelisis, di fayl de dɔp kwik, ɛnkripte, hosing na Yurup, ɛn opshɔn fɔ instal am na yu on sava.
strings.legal.security.intro: Wetin de apin fɔ yu fayl, we dɛn de proses am ɛn aw dɛn de protek am: ɛksplein sɔmpri, fɔ pɔsin ɛn IT dipatmɛnt.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: No dokumɛt de kep
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Yu fayl de proses awto, dɛn de pɔjam wɛn di rizin rɛdi o daonglod. No kɔpi de, no bakap de ɛn no histri de. Wan de awtomatik klining de pɔj ɛni tɛmpari fayl we efi de, by di nɛs de at di lest.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: No anelisis
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Nɔbɔdi de rid yu dokumɛt. Dɛn no de indeks am, anelisis, she o yus am fɔ tren atifishal intɛlijɛns. pdffusion no gɛt akaunt, no ad ɛn no yusar profil.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ēnkripte
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: ɔl kɔnɛkshɔn de ēnkripte (HTTPS) ɛn di sait de fos enkripte fɔ ɛni vizit (HSTS). Di Protek tul de enkripte yu PDF dɛn mit AES-256; di paswɛd we yu chus no de stop.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: We yu fayl de proses
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Sait, PDF ɛn picha tul dɛn: Vercel, Paris deta sɛnta (Frans, Yurupyun Yunian). Wɔd, Excel ɛn PowerPoint kɔnvɛshɔn: Render, na Frankfurt (Jɛmani, Yurupyun Yunian). Fayl mɔ pas 4 MB: tɛmpari Vercel Blob stɔj, anda random nem, pɔj afta yus.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Tɛknikal seft
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Sikyuriti hedaz (HSTS, blɔk di sait fɔ no go insay ɔda pej, protekshɔn agens fayl-kaen konfujon), tɛmpari fayl adrɛs we no efi gues, ɛn kɔnvɛshɔn savis we de aksɛp rɛkwɛt we gɛt sikrit tokin. Beni kod chenj de chɛk awto (test, tayp chɛk) bifo laiv.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Praivasi ɛn lɔ
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdffusion de kɔmɔt na New Brunswick ɛn e de folo Kanada Pɛsɔnal Infamɛshɔn Protekshɔn ɛn Elɛktronik Dokumɛt Akt (PIPEDA). E no de kɛlɛk pɛsɔnal infamɛshɔn bɔt yusar: no akaunt, no imel adrɛs, no trak kuki. E de bil on di sem prinsip lek di Yurupyun GDPR ɛn Kwebe lɔ 25: deta minimization, no riyus, pɔj afta prosesing.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Fɔ ɔganuzashɔn we gɛt stronge rul
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: If yu rul fɔbi sɛn dokumɛt fɔ awsaid savis, instal pdffusion na yu on sava. Di kɔmplit sɔftwia de fri, opn sɔs ɛn e de wok witawt Intanɛt kɔnɛkshɔn: no fayl efi kɔmɔt na yu nɛtwak. Di instalashɔn gaid de na di projɛk pej.

strings.legal.accessibility.description: pdffusion fɔ mek ɛnibɔdi efi yus am stetmɛt: WCAG 2.2 levul AA taget, mezha we de, lēmitashɔn we dɛn sabi ɛn aw fɔ ripɔt bari.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Enibɔdi fɔ efi yus pdffusion, ivin pɔsin we blain o no efi luk gud, we dif o no efi yia gud, o we gɛt mota o kognitiv disabiliti.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Taget standad
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdffusion taget fɔ konfom to di Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, levul AA, di intanashɔnal W3C standad. Dis levul kova di rikwaamɛnt blong di Gavament blong Kanada Standad on Web Accessibility, di Yurupyun standad EN 301 549 ɛn Sɛkshɔn 508 na Yunaitɛd Stet, we rɛfɛ to WCAG 2.0 o 2.1 levul AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Konfomans stetas
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion de konfom patlɛ to WCAG 2.2 levul AA: lēmitashɔn we dɛn sabi de na dis list. Dis stetmɛt de bas on intɛnal evalyueshon we dɛn mek na Oktoba 2, 2026, yusing awtomatik tul (axe, Lighthouse) ɛn manywal chɛk (kibod, kontrast, zum, anouns). No indepɛndɛnt audit dɛn mek yet.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Wetin de na ples
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Di wɛl sait de wok mit kibod, mit “Go na kontɛnt” link ɛn visibul autlain on di aktiv element. Tɛks kontrast de at list 4.5:1. Di step blong wan taji (apwod, rizin, era) de anouns fɔ skin rida. Fayl ɔda efi chenj witawt drak ɛn drop, yusing batɔn. Di sait de folo yu divais “ridus moshɔn” sɛtin: animeshɔn de stap kwik. Pej de stap ridibul at 400% zum ɛn na mobail. Di langwej blong ɛni pej de deklia, ɛn Arabik de sho rait to left.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Lēmitashɔn we dɛn sabi
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Witawt dat sɛtin, dekoreshɔn animeshɔn (bakgrɔn, ring, format tike) de ron continiu; di tike de pas on huva ɛn kibod fokus. Di animeshɔn ring on di hom pej de oparet mit mawsi o finga; e dekoreshiv, ɛn di list blong format we e sho de alaw as tɛks on di pej. Mashin-trenslet langwej efi gɛt inakjurat. Finli, di aksɛsabiliti blong dokumɛt depende on di orijinal: pdffusion no de ad aksɛsabiliti tag to PDF we no gɛt wan.
